# OVD Capital

> An operator-led investment firm in Chicago, Illinois. OVD Capital partners with founders and management teams of established, profitable businesses, bringing operating experience, flexible capital and the practical application of technology, including AI. Through OVD Advisory it delivers AI opportunity assessments and implementation to established businesses, private equity firms and family offices.

Principals: Alan Warms, Jamie Crouthamel, Gary Leff.
Contact: contact@ovdcapital.com

## Pages

- [OVD Capital — Experienced operators. Long-term partners.](https://ovdcapital.com/): OVD Capital partners with founders and management teams of established, profitable businesses, bringing operating experience, flexible capital and real, working applications of AI.
- [Our Approach — OVD Capital](https://ovdcapital.com/approach.html): We partner with successful businesses to develop and execute a focused plan for long-term growth and value creation.
- [Where We Focus — OVD Capital](https://ovdcapital.com/where-we-focus.html): We focus on established companies where our operating experience, capital and network can be useful in the next stage of growth.
- [For Founders — OVD Capital](https://ovdcapital.com/founders.html): You have spent years building the business. Our role is to respect that foundation and help create more options for what comes next.
- [Investments — OVD Capital](https://ovdcapital.com/investments.html): Experience built across operating, investing and board roles, spanning technology, digital commerce, consumer products, hospitality, gaming, food and beverage and manufacturing.
- [Who We Are — OVD Capital](https://ovdcapital.com/who-we-are.html): Alan Warms, Jamie Crouthamel and Gary Leff have spent their careers building, running, investing in and advising businesses.
- [OVD Advisory — AI Opportunity Assessments for Established Businesses](https://ovdcapital.com/advisory.html): OVD Advisory helps established businesses, private equity firms and family offices identify, prioritize and plan practical applications of AI, tied to measurable business objectives.
- [Contact — OVD Capital](https://ovdcapital.com/contact.html): If you are considering a partner for the next stage of your business, we would be glad to learn more about what you have built and what you want to accomplish.
